subject: AWS: Intro request for Orchard Health — joint account playbook
messages:
From: Ben Walker <ben.walker@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: AWS: Intro request for Orchard Health — joint account playbook

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from the AWS marketplace side — Orchard Health is evaluating an LLM-based triage/workflow assistant and asked us to loop in Redwood for a co-sell intro. They currently have a procurement window in Q3 and asked for a joint account plan that covers deployment topology + procurement steps so they can present to their IT/security committee.

Can you connect us with the right Redwood stakeholders (AE, CSM, solution lead)? Suggested next step: 30-minute intro + 30-minute deep-dive with Orchard and their technical lead. I can bring the AWS GTM/Marketplace checklist.

Attachments: co-sell-intake-form.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — would love to get something on the calendar for next week.

Best,
Ben Walker
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
ben.walker@amazon.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Walker <ben.walker@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS: Intro request for Orchard Health — joint account playbook

Thanks Ben — looping in Marissa (partnerships/AE) and Sean (CSM) so we can coordinate.

Marissa / Sean — AWS has requested a co-sell intro to Orchard Health; they want a joint account plan and a short procurement-facing artifact for Orchard's security committee. Ben attached the intake form; Ben, can you confirm the Orchard technical contact and any preferred templates?

Proposed agenda for a 60-min kickoff:
- 5m intros and mutual context
- 10m Orchard priorities + procurement timeline
- 20m solution fit / deployment topology (Redwood + AWS infra)
- 15m procurement & compliance checklist (SOC2, data residency, onboarding steps)
- 10m next steps / mutual action plan

Availability: I can do Mon/Tue mornings next week (PT). Marissa — can you lead the joint account plan draft? Sean — can you join for the compliance and onboarding pieces?

Karthik
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Walker <ben.walker@amazon.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Olivia Grant <olivia@orchardhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS: Intro request for Orchard Health — joint account playbook

Karthik — perfect, thanks for the quick turn. Looping in Olivia Grant from Orchard (copied). Olivia — appreciate you taking this — a short intro below.

Olivia, meet Karthik, Marissa and Sean from Redwood. They’ll help map a joint account plan and clear next steps for procurement. I’ve attached Orchard-specific context (orchard-account-context.docx) and pre-filled the co-sell intake form with what we have so far.

Olivia — are you available Thu 18 Jun at 10:00 AM PT for a 60-minute kickoff? If not, propose a couple of windows.

Attachments: orchard-account-context.docx (stub)

--
Ben Walker
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@orchardhealth.com>, Ben Walker <ben.walker@amazon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS: Intro request for Orchard Health — joint account playbook

Great — thanks Olivia and Ben. Thu 18 Jun 10:00 AM PT works for our team; I’ve sent a calendar invite.

Attachments I’ll bring to the kickoff: joint_account_plan_template.xlsx (stub), aws-intro-slide-deck.pdf (stub).

Pre-read for the meeting (quick asks for Olivia):
- Any existing security/compliance docs you can share (SOC2 report or contact for compliance)?
- Primary technical contact for deployment (name, email, expected node footprint)
- Procurement contact and preferred contract vehicle (PO vs. signed MSA)

If you want, Marissa will take the first pass on the mutual action plan during the call and share a follow-up. Looking forward to it.
